name: get_ad
description: Full details of 1-5 ads by id or blocket.se URL: description, specs, equipment, all photos, place, status (active/sold/removed), seller (dealer, years on Blocket, other ads via seller.id), shipping/buy-now, favourites count, red flags and vehicle history links. Several ids render a comparison.

arguments.name: ids
arguments.desc: Ad ids from search rows, or blocket.se ad URLs.

name: get_ad_photos
description: An ad's photos as images (640 px wide JPEGs) to look at the item's condition yourself, plus its title, url and total photo count. Returns the first max photos (default 4, up to 8).

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Ad id from a search row, or a blocket.se ad URL.

arguments.name: max
arguments.desc: Number of photos, default 4, at most 8.

name: list_filters
description: Filter names and values (with live ad counts) available for a vertical, to use in search.filters. Pass filter to list one filter's values, query to find values by substring (e.g. filter 'make', query 'hallberg').

arguments.name: filter
arguments.desc: One filter name (e.g. 'make') to list all its values.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Substring to find filter values by (e.g. 'hallberg').

arguments.name: vertical
arguments.desc: torget = general marketplace (furniture, electronics, clothes, kids, hobby, tools...); car, boat, mc (motorcycles), caravan (husvagn), motorhome (husbil), truck (lastbil/släp), tractor, combine (skördetröska), snowmobile, atv, moped (mopeder/scooters), bus.

name: price_check
description: Asking-price distribution (p10/p25/median/p75/p90) of comparable live ads, with up to 6 example ads. Give ad_id to judge that ad (comparables are derived from its make, model, year, mileage or length; its percentile is returned), or describe the item with the search filters. For Torget items pass a short query (e.g. 'iphone 13 128gb') for good comparables. Explicit filters override the derived ones.

arguments.name: ad_id
arguments.desc: Ad id or blocket.se URL to judge.

arguments.name: filters
arguments.desc: Vertical-specific filters by Blocket filter name → value label(s) or {min,max}. Examples: car {make: 'Volvo', model: 'V70', fuel: 'Diesel', transmission: 'Automatisk', body_type: 'Kombi', car_equipment: ['Dragkrok']}; boat {class: 'Segelbåt', make: 'Najad', length_feet: {min: 28}}; torget {category: 'Möbler och inredning', condition: 'Mycket bra skick - som ny', brand: 'IKEA'}. Unsure? Call list_filters.

arguments.name: mileage_max_mil
arguments.desc: Highest mileage in Swedish mil (1 mil = 10 km).

arguments.name: mileage_min_mil
arguments.desc: Lowest mileage in Swedish mil (1 mil = 10 km).

arguments.name: near
arguments.desc: Only ads within radius_km of a point; rows then carry distance_km.

arguments.name: new_today
arguments.desc: Only ads published today.

arguments.name: places
arguments.desc: Counties (län) or municipalities, e.g. ['Stockholm'], ['Nacka', 'Värmdö'], ['Västra Götaland']. Omit for all of Sweden.

arguments.name: price_max
arguments.desc: Highest price, SEK.

arguments.name: price_min
arguments.desc: Lowest price, SEK.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Search words, ideally Swedish ('soffa', 'barnvagn', 'V70', 'Hallberg-Rassy'). Blocket operators: -word excludes a word, a OR b matches either, "exact phrase", word* matches a prefix.

arguments.name: seller
arguments.desc: Only private sellers or only dealers (companies).

arguments.name: seller_id
arguments.desc: Only this seller's ads (seller.id from a row or get_ad).

arguments.name: shipping
arguments.desc: Torget only: only ads that can be shipped.

arguments.name: trade
arguments.desc: Torget only: for sale (Säljes), free giveaways (Bortskänkes) or wanted ads (Köpes).

arguments.name: vertical
arguments.desc: Default torget, or the ad's vertical with ad_id. torget = general marketplace (furniture, electronics, clothes, kids, hobby, tools...); car, boat, mc (motorcycles), caravan (husvagn), motorhome (husbil), truck (lastbil/släp), tractor, combine (skördetröska), snowmobile, atv, moped (mopeder/scooters), bus.

arguments.name: year_max
arguments.desc: Latest model year (vehicles).

arguments.name: year_min
arguments.desc: Earliest model year (vehicles).

name: search
description: Search live Blocket ads in any vertical with filters, distance and sorting. Returns compact rows (price, place, age, seller, badges, key specs, url, photo, risk_words), the total count, the filters applied, unmatched filter values with suggestions, optional facets (value counts to refine with) and blocket_url (the same search on blocket.se). exclude/require/title_only drop off-topic rows and read up to 4 more pages to refill (scanned, dropped, next_page). deals labels each row's price against the same search's asking prices (deal_basis).

arguments.name: deals
arguments.desc: Label each row's price great/good/fair/high with its percentile and % vs the median asking price of up to 200 ads of the same search (deal_basis). Costs one extra request.

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.desc: Drop rows whose title or specs contain any of these (case-insensitive, also inside words), e.g. ['skal', 'laddare', 'köpes'] for a phone. 'köpes' and 'bortskänkes' also drop wanted ads and giveaways.

arguments.name: facets
arguments.desc: Also return value counts for the main filters (market overview, refining).

arguments.name: filters
arguments.desc: Vertical-specific filters by Blocket filter name → value label(s) or {min,max}. Examples: car {make: 'Volvo', model: 'V70', fuel: 'Diesel', transmission: 'Automatisk', body_type: 'Kombi', car_equipment: ['Dragkrok']}; boat {class: 'Segelbåt', make: 'Najad', length_feet: {min: 28}}; torget {category: 'Möbler och inredning', condition: 'Mycket bra skick - som ny', brand: 'IKEA'}. Unsure? Call list_filters.

arguments.name: mileage_max_mil
arguments.desc: Highest mileage in Swedish mil (1 mil = 10 km).

arguments.name: mileage_min_mil
arguments.desc: Lowest mileage in Swedish mil (1 mil = 10 km).

arguments.name: near
arguments.desc: Only ads within radius_km of a point; rows then carry distance_km.

arguments.name: new_today
arguments.desc: Only ads published today.

arguments.name: page
arguments.desc: Blocket result page, default 1. Pass next_page from a previous response to continue.

arguments.name: places
arguments.desc: Counties (län) or municipalities, e.g. ['Stockholm'], ['Nacka', 'Värmdö'], ['Västra Götaland']. Omit for all of Sweden.

arguments.name: price_max
arguments.desc: Highest price, SEK.

arguments.name: price_min
arguments.desc: Lowest price, SEK.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Search words, ideally Swedish ('soffa', 'barnvagn', 'V70', 'Hallberg-Rassy'). Blocket operators: -word excludes a word, a OR b matches either, "exact phrase", word* matches a prefix.

arguments.name: require
arguments.desc: Words or phrases that must all appear in the row's title or specs (case-insensitive), e.g. ['128gb'].

arguments.name: rows
arguments.desc: Ads per page, default 20. With exclude/require/title_only a response can hold a few more.

arguments.name: seller
arguments.desc: Only private sellers or only dealers (companies).

arguments.name: seller_id
arguments.desc: Only this seller's ads (seller.id from a row or get_ad).

arguments.name: shipping
arguments.desc: Torget only: only ads that can be shipped.

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: ISO time: only ads published after it (newest first). Use for 'anything new since…'.

arguments.name: sort
arguments.desc: Default relevance. closest needs near; year_*/mileage_* vehicles; length_* boats. deal = cheapest vs the median first (implies deals).

arguments.name: title_only
arguments.desc: Keep only rows whose title contains every word of query.

arguments.name: trade
arguments.desc: Torget only: for sale (Säljes), free giveaways (Bortskänkes) or wanted ads (Köpes).

arguments.name: vertical
arguments.desc: Default torget. torget = general marketplace (furniture, electronics, clothes, kids, hobby, tools...); car, boat, mc (motorcycles), caravan (husvagn), motorhome (husbil), truck (lastbil/släp), tractor, combine (skördetröska), snowmobile, atv, moped (mopeder/scooters), bus.

arguments.name: year_max
arguments.desc: Latest model year (vehicles).

arguments.name: year_min
arguments.desc: Earliest model year (vehicles).
